reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully covers supplier onboarding and proposal management.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and represents an independent outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Supplier registers, submits proposals, and receives feedback; no other HLG covers this end-to-end process.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects proposal evaluation and automation.

decisions.rationale: The parent is independently documented and covers a distinct administrative outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator evaluates proposals, handles delays, and ensures timely decisions; no other HLG duplicates this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction matches real-time inventory and replenishment logic.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and covers a distinct operational outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator manages inventory, triggers reorders, and ensures product availability; no other HLG duplicates this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects goods receiving and placement.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and covers a distinct operational outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Goods-Receiving Staff verifies deliveries, assigns locations, and flags defects; no other HLG duplicates this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction conflates order fulfillment with proposal evaluation.

decisions.rationale: The parent mixes two distinct outcomes; the source assigns order fulfillment to Order Department Staff.
decisions.outcome_justification: Order Department Staff processes orders, handles payments, and manages partial deliveries; proposal evaluation belongs to Administrator.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Separate order fulfillment (payment processing, delivery status) from proposal management (evaluation, reminders).

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects online shopping and payment.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and covers a distinct customer outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer browses, purchases, pays, and tracks orders; no other HLG duplicates this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately reflects support ticket lifecycle.

decisions.rationale: The parent is source-supported and covers a distinct operational outcome.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer-Service Agent manages tickets, responds to inquiries, and tracks performance; no other HLG duplicates this.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits strategic decision-making; focuses on report generation.

decisions.rationale: The parent conflates data collection with analysis; the source assigns both to Administrator.
decisions.outcome_justification: Administrator collects and analyzes operational data to inform strategic decisions; report generation is a workflow step.
decisions.rewriting_focus: Express data-driven decision-making (analysis, optimization) distinct from report generation.
